authorization: User accepted seasonal source/population/food/work qualification, followed by civilian/staff and affected-chain checks. Northern-steppe climate side quest is archived; no new climate fitting in this stage.
purpose: An actual isolated published-versus-candidate seasonal support map, not another size fit. Retain fixed seed1 town locations, original population/crop/work/transport packets and calibrated marketed shares. Trace finite people at physical source cells; recalculate remaining rural workers and food; certify bounded supported allocations or preserve failure. No adoption, publication or new source pool.
people_provenance: Record the canonical annual own-hinterland and sequential wider-region withdrawals as a sparse physical-cell-to-town matrix W. Fixed-site ownership/ties and draw order/radii/fractions exactly retain the published/candidate recipes. Before seasonal interpretation, require W column totals and all-ones remaining rural grid to reproduce the reviewed seed1 actual residents and rural arrays at numerical precision; row withdrawals must not exceed original people. Retain all eight mode/model/reading controls. Conditional reductions scale each town's recorded source mix, returning people to those exact physical cells; do not redraw placement, recruitment priority or transfer geography to improve support. This fixed-mix restriction is a scenario, not calibrated migration.
finite_allocator: Reuse existing settlement_residents.allocate_residents with one demographic shard per nonzero W link, original shard population W.data, owner=destination, transfer fraction=trial town fraction. Physical-cell nonmovable people plus returned shards reconstruct rural population. Shards partition population only: NEVER copy crop land, grain or worker budgets per shard. Each physical cell's production is evaluated once from aggregated remaining rural residents. Total candidate site residents cap civilian AND institutional residents together; existing100-person cohort and50-person minimum, original affiliation,2500kcal/day,365-day year. Cohorts reserve inside the cap, never on top.
source_food_work: Reuse field_support and fixed_rural_food on physical cells, .4worker fraction,600/300annual field hours,30reaping days at8hours. Preserve existing earliest eligible harvest-boundary policy, annual edible cereal energy and all rural annual food claims. Calendar bits are alternative eligible harvest boundaries, not additional crops; annual energy enters ONCE at earliest eligible bit. Rural store365d, annual storage loss.05. Only fully seasonally rural-supported origins may export their actual food-year overflow. Existing deficits elsewhere remain counted and block any all-world-supported claim; no starving cell exports its meals. This is partial cereal/listed-field work under inherited timing, not a complete diet, household/draft or empirical crop-calendar qualification.
seasonal_network: Recover FOUR separate within-town freight matrices at existing TRADE_MONTHS0/3/6/9 using exact released supply world, nodes and canonical physics. Require their arithmetic mean and full-precision origin owner/share arrays to match the reviewed annual cache before candidate use. Preserve historical supply-track ordering distinction. Explicit seasonal approximation: month bins0..2 use season0,3..5 season3,etc; no claim all12 monthly networks were independently reconstructed. Each source-to-town delivery uses its actual seasonal owner/share. One accounting-bin transport delay per leg, existing270road-km value limit and delivered-share rule. No transport capacity calibration or new travel recipe.
source_exports: Market only the declared fraction of rural-protected overflow. One-year export store per physical origin,5percent annual loss. Intended dispatch is marketed annual total/12 in accessible bins; actual dispatch is capped by the origin's repeating export inventory. Grain remains in inaccessible origin stores or is spoiled/unused; no grain invented from an annual average. Reconstruct all source departures, receiving-town arrivals and paid transport loss with one-bin delay.
town_trade: Direct-arrival local stores90days protect current trial town meals first. Only towns fully supported by direct arrivals may export, and only their actual monthly inventory overflow; they never import. In each month, use canonical cheapest-first delivered-share shipment rule on that season's town network, bounded by exporter overflow and recipient's direct-only unmet meals in the NEXT bin. Delay inter-town deliveries by one bin. No onward re-export, future-harvest borrowing or unconstrained annual pooling. Final town inventory uses direct+intertown arrivals; exports are funded exclusively from otherwise-unused overflow, and net unused grain subtracts those exports exactly once. This conservative dispatch rule is declared, not an optimized trade equilibrium.
coupling_solver: Start from complete reviewed annual town requests. At every trial recalculate physical rural people/work/production, protected rural food, source/export stores, seasonal routes, direct town stores and inter-town trade. The existing finite allocator caps trial residents by continuous12-bin destination food. Update trial downwards to returned allocation, never increasing above a previously tested cap; at most64iterations. Convergence requires max per-town downward step<=1e-6people or1e-10of that town's original request, followed by fresh final trial and food/population checks. Report every step and limit; preserve nonconvergence as unqualified, not a made-up feasible result. This is a bounded downward supported allocation under a fixed source mix, not maximum sustainable population or global optimum. Inaccessible towns can reachzero; zero is not a successful occupied town.
food_audit: The old audit_origin_food assumes one population/food owner and homogeneous retention/delay. Do not claim it directly accepts heterogeneous seasonal wide freight. Add an isolated network audit over original physical rural, export and town inventories, route edge amounts, losses and net unused stocks. Retain exact reduction controls against existing audit_origin_food on its one-owner/homogeneous cases. Reuse existing finite allocator for actual populations. Generalized audit must reject duplicated grain, unfunded exports, changed worker/rural claims, excess destination people or unclosed stocks; retain unaffected rural deficits. All grains/people counted once across the network.
controls_review: Before interpreting results, all eight people provenance replays and both separate-season network-to-annual controls pass. Meaningful tests: restricted legacy audit equivalence; source-shard people conservation; zero/deficit-origin exports prohibited; seasonal stocks cannot borrow nonexistent reserves; exports bounded by real overflow and imports by link losses; funding cohorts inside residents; tampered grain audit rejection. Independent final people/field-work equations, separate inventory replay, all routes and source/town/whole-ledger sums, current source/protected identities and exact compact fresh replay. Disclose reused physics/stock primitives. Track compact town/summary artifacts and static support maps; ignore large source/flow caches.
downstream_gate: Export actual supported civilians, institutional cohorts/active flags and losses for subsequent affected staffing/reach/trade rebuilds. Rebuilding reach on an unreviewed or unqualified seasonal allocation is blocked. This stage does not by itself qualify recruitment rights, institutional roles, complete labour/diet or historical transfer. No main default or atlas adoption; appropriate evidence and affected-chain review still required. Climate side quest remains archived.
